_comment: Every simulation under public/simulations/, for the student dashboard (public/dashboard/)
and the Simulations hub (public/simulations/), which renders its cards from this list in
this order. subject, grades, minutes and standard are the hub card's labels.
learn and note are optional extra lines on the hub card.
Each simulation ALSO has a type 'sim' entry in modules-registry.json (since 2026-11-25), so
Mission Control can assign and track it; `simulationId` there names the row here. Cards
still render from this list. Simulations do no skill routing. scripts/check-modules.js
fails the build if a folder under public/simulations/ is missing from this list, or a row

simulations.name: Where rain comes from
simulations.subject: Science
simulations.blurb: Why does one side of a mountain get soaked while the other stays dry? Warm an ocean, turn on the wind, and figure out the water cycle for yourself.
learn: Why rising air makes clouds and rain
Rain shadows, tested on a real island
simulations.note: Science checked against USGS, NOAA, and the National Weather Service. The rain shadow step also supports NGSS MS-ESS2-5.

simulations.name: Reasons for the Seasons
simulations.subject: Science
simulations.blurb: Steer Earth around the Sun on a copper orrery and find out what really makes summer and winter.

simulations.name: Wolves & Deer
simulations.subject: Science
simulations.blurb: Fly a winter survey over a snowy valley and figure out why deer and wolf numbers rise and fall together.

simulations.name: The Snowball
simulations.subject: Life skills: money
simulations.standard: National Standards for Personal Financial Education
simulations.blurb: Roll a snowball down the hill of your life and find out why starting early beats saving more later.
